# ai.Client: explicit transport start and a test-only registry boot

Part of #20370 (linked natively); graduated from D#18775, option F. The epic carries the shared rationale.

## Context

Loading the AI stack today means opening a socket: `construct()` builds the six services and then calls `connect()` (`src/ai/Client.mjs:155`). This leaf separates the two inside the one registered Client, with no new class, so a test boot can host the dispatcher with no transport.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/worker/App.mjs:782` imports `ai/Client.mjs` when `useAiClient` is `true`, an environment array containing `config.environment`, or an environment string, and never on GitHub Pages.
- `handleRequest` reaches `dispatchServiceMethod` (`src/ai/Client.mjs:212`) without the socket. D#18775 measured this at `0eec51e5`: a trapped socket saw zero reads across reads, an enforced write and its undo.
- `allowVdomUpdatesInTests` (`src/DefaultConfig.mjs:244`) is the precedent for a test-only flag.
- `test/playwright/e2e/core/AiClientLateBridge.spec.mjs` pins late-bridge recovery.

## The Fix

1. `Client#construct` no longer calls `connect()`. The App boot starts transport after construction when `useAiClient` resolves true, for each of its three forms.
2. A test-only `DefaultConfig` flag (name open, for example `allowAiClientInTests`), default `false`. When it is true, the App boot constructs the Client without starting transport and exposes a test dispatch entry on the App Worker.
3. The test entry refuses a call whose context lacks a complete `{agentId, sessionId}` pair (`parseAgentEnvelope`'s shape) before `dispatchServiceMethod`. The legacy null context, which admits a write without a lock, is unreachable from it.
4. Console lines are buffered only for a started transport. `src/worker/Base.mjs:interceptConsole` pushes into `client.logs` whenever the client is not connected, so a registry-only boot, which never connects, would retain every line. The Client owns that answer (no transport, nothing to flush to), so the change stays in `Client.mjs`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.ai.Client#construct` | `src/ai/Client.mjs:155` | builds the services, starts no transport | none | JSDoc | zero-socket unit spec |
| App boot transport start | `src/worker/App.mjs:782` | starts transport iff `useAiClient` resolves true, all three forms | unchanged without the flag | JSDoc | one spec per form |
| test-only flag (new) | `src/DefaultConfig.mjs` | default `false`; `true` boots the registry without transport and exposes the test entry | flag off: no test entry | `DefaultConfig` JSDoc | spec |
| test dispatch entry (new) | App Worker | refuses an incomplete pair before dispatch, else calls `handleRequest(method, params, context)` | none | JSDoc | refusal unit spec |

## Discussion Criteria Mapping & Leaf Slice

OQ4 (`useAiClient` keeps its meaning; the flag defaults to `false`), OQ2's refusal mechanism, option F's five falsifiers, and STEP_BACK points 4 and 6. The production touchpoints are exactly:

<!-- binding-inventory: production-touchpoints -->
- `src/ai/Client.mjs`
- `src/worker/App.mjs`
- `src/DefaultConfig.mjs`
<!-- /binding-inventory -->

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] No production file outside the three above changes.
- [ ] A registry-only boot records zero WebSocket constructions across construction and the App's focus and visibility lifecycle events.
- [ ] Each `useAiClient` form (`true`, an environment array, an environment string) still connects in a production boot, and a boot without the flag exposes no test entry.
- [ ] `AiClientLateBridge.spec.mjs` passes unchanged.
- [ ] Repeated initialisation yields one Client, teardown destroys its services, and the flag can be set before the App boots.
- [ ] The flag defaults to `false` and is documented in `DefaultConfig`'s JSDoc.
- [ ] The test entry refuses a call with an incomplete pair before dispatch (unit spec).
- [ ] A registry-only boot retains no console lines, while a production boot still flushes the lines logged before its socket opened.

## Out of Scope

The harness adapter, the contract spec suite, CI selection and the artifact check (sibling leaves); SharedWorker apps.

Prescription checked: `src/ai/Client.mjs` (with `src/worker/App.mjs`), which owns the concern. The registry and transport fusion lives in `construct()`, and the App boot owns the three `useAiClient` forms. One reader the ticket missed: `src/worker/Base.mjs:interceptConsole` buffers into `client.logs` while the client is unconnected, which in a registry-only boot means forever. The Client owns that answer, so it stays inside `Client.mjs`. This is now Fix item 4 plus an AC, and the `production-touchpoints` inventory is unchanged.
